claim_to_evidence.computational_checks: The standalone independent enumeration checks all naturally labeled posets up to six vertices (5231 distinct closure relations in all orders one through six) with exact exhaustive Littlestone recurrence, width and threshold rigidity. A second arithmetic loop checks balanced threshold formulas for \(1\le w\le10\) and \(w\le K<30\).
critical_proof_steps: Chain of length l has exactly l+1 prefixes and adaptive depth \(\lfloor\log_2(\ell+1)\rfloor\).
Disjoint-query Cartesian products have additive adaptive depth, proved by a version-space potential induction.
Dilworth w-chain partition injects J(P) into a product of chain-prefix hypothesis families; sum of integer ranks upper bounds Ldim.
Balancing the positive integer ranks k_i at sum K gives minimum order \(N_w(K)\)=\(2^q(w+r)-w\).

At minimum order there are at most \(2^K\) prefix tuples; a shattered depth-K tree needs \(2^K\) distinct ideals. Equality means all tuples occur, ruling out all cross-chain relations and proving uniqueness.
Adding one global minimum gives a connected example attaining K; adding new global top elements pads every n without lowering K.
Antichains are precisely the potentially shattered fixed query sets, proving \(\operatorname{VCdim}=w\).
claim_to_evidence.exact_domain: All finite nonempty partially ordered sets P with Boolean concepts the indicators of all lower ideals, including empty, queried by membership of individual ground elements. Width \(w\ge1\), requested adaptive depth \(K\ge w\); connected threshold only \(w\ge2\).
claim_to_evidence.unproved_limits: No theorem characterizes all larger nonminimal extremizers or all connected minimum-order isomorphism types; the finite enumeration is not an exhaustive verification of all posets. Historical absolute priority and independent audit are not established.

correctness.rationale: The proof gives exact integer quantifiers \(w\ge1\), \(K\ge w\) and P finite nonempty. Dilworth yields w nonempty chains, each ideal determines a valid prefix tuple, and monotonicity plus proved disjoint-domain product additivity bounds the online rank by the sum of the chain ranks. A chain of length l has exactly l+1 prefix ideals and online rank \(\lfloor\log_2(\ell+1)\rfloor\), proved by recursive binary splitting. The integer exchange argument minimizes sum (\(2^{k_i}-1\)) at balanced positive k_i and yields \(N_w(K)\). At equality there are at most \(2^K\) prefix tuples and at least \(2^K\) distinct witnesses, so every prefix tuple must occur; this forbids any relation between distinct chains and proves the unique isomorphism type. Adding a global minimum proves the one-extra-vertex connected bound for \(w\ge2\), and adding universally maximal elements extends sharpness to every \(n\ge w\). VC dimension=width follows exactly from antichain shattering. The independent finite program computes rank recurrences on all 5231 naturally labeled posets through six vertices (1+2+7+40+357+4824=5231) and checks threshold and uniqueness. The finite check is corroboration; the unrestricted proof is structural.

originality.rationale: Targeted exact-formula, poset-ideal, chain-product and online-shattering searches found no prior implication establishing simultaneously the all-width exact threshold, unique minimum-order extremizers, fixed-order maximum, and sharp connected one-element surcharge. Liu--Weselcouch study order-ideal lattice embeddings and P-partition generating functions; Ghazi et al. give coarse closure bounds for same-domain pointwise aggregations; Guingona et al. characterize unrelated linear zero-set concept classes. Classical chain decomposition and finite-class counting are used as ingredients, but do not by themselves state the classification or rigidity. Absolute historical priority is not asserted.
residual_risks: An older or unindexed specialist work may already formulate the same sharp bounded-width order-ideal learning threshold under alternate terminology such as mistake-tree rank, adversarial membership search, or thicket dimension.
A more general theorem on product subclasses of chain thresholds might imply the result even without naming posets. No exhaustive historical-priority claim is made.

value.rationale: Exact, natural two-parameter extremal and rigidity theorem for order-ideal membership classes: every (width \(w\), target adaptive depth \(K\)) has a sharp first feasible cardinality, and at that cardinality one completely classified isomorphism type. Connectivity has exactly one element of overhead and all fixed-size maxima follow. Since VC dimension of ideals is identically w, the result computes the largest possible adaptive-versus-static gap under both width and order constraints. This structural precision and uniqueness extend beyond a mere count or routine finite example; no arbitrary slice, external application, or conjectural future theorem is needed for value.
